title: Where does one action take you?
hook: Choose a move and inspect what it pays.

doesNotKnow: how a terminal state stops this finite process

misconception: A reward is a supplied label telling the agent the correct action.
objective: Identify state, action, reward and next state in a deterministic fully observed transition table.

claims.text: The deterministic fully observed toy has A/right → B with reward 0, B/right → terminal C with reward 2; stay at A or B yields the same state and reward 0. C cannot move.

recall.question: A toy move X → Y gives reward −1. Which item is the reward?
recall.why: The reward is the number received on the transition; Y is the next state.
